baseline_context: Mid-market engagement, 500-5000 users, single domain, standard complexity

tasks.name: Technical Discovery & Environment Assessment
tasks.description: Inventory current email/collaboration environment. Document user counts, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, mail flow rules, third-party integrations, and data volumes. Identify migration blockers.

tasks.name: Stakeholder Alignment & Kickoff
tasks.description: Conduct kickoff meetings with client executive sponsor, IT leads, and change champions. Establish communication cadence, escalation paths, and decision-making authority. Document RACI.

tasks.name: Migration Architecture & Approach Design
tasks.description: Define migration waves, coexistence strategy, DNS cutover plan, and rollback procedures. Select migration tooling. Document technical approach for client approval.

tasks.name: Google Workspace Tenant Configuration
tasks.description: Provision and configure Google Workspace tenant. Set up organizational units, groups, admin roles, and security policies. Configure MX records for mail routing during coexistence.

tasks.name: Directory Sync & Identity Setup
tasks.description: Configure Google Cloud Directory Sync (GCDS) or equivalent. Set up identity federation (SAML SSO) with client IdP. Test user provisioning and deprovisioning flows.

tasks.name: Email Migration — Batch Execution
tasks.description: Execute email migration in planned waves using selected tooling. Monitor throughput, resolve per-user errors, validate mailbox integrity post-migration. Typically 3-5 waves.

tasks.name: Drive / File Migration
tasks.description: Migrate file shares, personal drives, and shared drives to Google Drive. Map permissions, handle file type incompatibilities, and validate folder structures post-migration.

tasks.name: End User Training — Core Applications
tasks.description: Deliver training sessions on Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet. Tailored to user personas (general staff, power users, executives). Typically 3-4 sessions.

tasks.name: Train the Trainer Program
tasks.description: Identify and train internal champions who will provide ongoing support post-engagement. Develop training materials and quick reference guides for distribution.

tasks.name: Change Management & Communications Plan
tasks.description: Develop and execute internal communications plan for the migration. Include executive messaging, department-specific impact summaries, FAQ documents, and go-live announcements.

tasks.name: DNS Cutover & Mail Flow Transition
tasks.description: Execute MX record cutover to route mail through Google. Validate mail flow, SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, and transport rules. Monitor for delivery failures during transition period.

tasks.name: Post-Migration Validation & Hypercare
tasks.description: Two-week hypercare period. Monitor support tickets, resolve migration-related issues, validate data integrity, and confirm all users are operational on Google Workspace.

tasks.name: Third-Party Integration Configuration
tasks.description: Configure integrations between Google Workspace and client's existing tools (CRM, HRIS, ticketing systems, etc.). Test OAuth flows, API connectivity, and data sync.

tasks.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Policy Configuration
tasks.description: Configure DLP rules in Google Workspace admin console. Define sensitive data detectors, set up alerting, and establish remediation workflows for policy violations.

tasks.name: Mobile Device Management (MDM) Setup
tasks.description: Configure Google Endpoint Management for mobile device policies. Set up device approval workflows, enforce security policies (screen lock, encryption), and configure app management.

tasks.name: Cloud Architecture Design & Review
tasks.description: Design target GCP architecture including VPC layout, subnet strategy, firewall rules, IAM structure, and service selection. Produce architecture diagram and design document for client review.

tasks.name: GCP Organization & Project Setup
tasks.description: Establish GCP organization structure, create project hierarchy, configure billing accounts, and set up resource quotas. Implement folder structure aligned to client organizational model.

tasks.name: Network Configuration (VPC, Subnets, Firewall)
tasks.description: Provision VPCs, configure subnets across regions, set up firewall rules and Cloud NAT. Establish VPN or Interconnect connectivity to on-premises if required.

tasks.name: IAM & Access Control Configuration
tasks.description: Implement IAM roles, service accounts, and access policies. Configure organization policies, VPC service controls if applicable. Set up audit logging for access events.

tasks.name: Compute Infrastructure Provisioning
tasks.description: Deploy Compute Engine instances, GKE clusters, or Cloud Run services as defined in architecture. Configure instance templates, managed instance groups, and autoscaling policies.

tasks.name: Application Migration & Deployment
tasks.description: Migrate or deploy client applications to GCP compute targets. Configure CI/CD pipelines, environment variables, secrets management, and health checks.

tasks.name: Monitoring, Logging & Alerting Setup
tasks.description: Configure Cloud Monitoring dashboards, log sinks, alerting policies, and uptime checks. Set up incident response workflows and notification channels.

tasks.name: Load Testing & Performance Validation
tasks.description: Execute load tests against migrated applications. Validate performance against SLAs, identify bottlenecks, and tune infrastructure configuration as needed.

tasks.name: Disaster Recovery & Backup Configuration
tasks.description: Implement backup schedules, snapshot policies, and DR procedures. Document RTO/RPO targets and validate failover procedures.

tasks.name: Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) Development
tasks.description: Codify GCP infrastructure using Terraform modules. Establish state management, implement CI/CD for infrastructure changes, and document module usage.

tasks.name: Data Architecture & Schema Design
tasks.description: Design data warehouse schema in BigQuery. Define datasets, tables, views, and materialized views. Establish naming conventions and partitioning strategy.

tasks.name: ETL Pipeline Development
tasks.description: Build data ingestion pipelines using Dataflow, Cloud Composer, or Dataproc. Implement data validation, transformation logic, and error handling. Schedule recurring jobs.

tasks.name: Looker Dashboard Development
tasks.description: Build Looker models, explores, and dashboards. Configure data connections, define LookML model layer, and create user-facing dashboard views aligned to client KPIs.

tasks.name: Data Migration & Validation
tasks.description: Migrate data from source systems to BigQuery. Execute data quality checks, reconcile row counts and aggregates, and document known data quality issues.

tasks.name: API Integration (Apigee) Setup
tasks.description: Configure Apigee API gateway. Define API proxies, policies, rate limiting, and developer portal. Set up analytics and monitoring for API usage.

tasks.name: Security Assessment & Gap Analysis
tasks.description: Assess client's current security posture against GCP best practices and relevant compliance frameworks. Document gaps and produce remediation roadmap.

tasks.name: Security Command Center Configuration
tasks.description: Enable and configure Security Command Center (SCC). Set up finding notifications, vulnerability scanning, and compliance monitoring dashboards.

tasks.name: Encryption & Key Management Setup
tasks.description: Configure Cloud KMS for customer-managed encryption keys. Implement encryption policies for data at rest and in transit. Document key rotation procedures.

tasks.name: VPC Service Controls Implementation
tasks.description: Define and deploy VPC Service Controls perimeters to restrict data exfiltration. Configure access levels, ingress/egress policies, and bridge perimeters.

tasks.name: Chrome Browser Policy Configuration
tasks.description: Configure Chrome Browser Cloud Management policies. Set up extension allow/block lists, security policies, and update management.

tasks.name: ChromeOS Device Fleet Deployment
tasks.description: Provision and enroll ChromeOS devices. Configure device policies, network settings, kiosk mode if applicable. Plan rollout waves and device distribution.

tasks.name: Project Planning & Schedule Development
tasks.description: Develop detailed project schedule with work breakdown structure, milestones, and resource assignments. Establish JIRA project with sprint structure and backlog.

tasks.name: Risk & Issue Management Setup
tasks.description: Establish risk register, issue log, and decision log. Define severity classifications, escalation procedures, and review cadence. Conduct initial risk assessment.

tasks.name: Weekly Status Reporting
tasks.description: Prepare and deliver weekly status reports to client stakeholders. Track action items, update project health indicators, and document decisions. Runs for engagement duration.

tasks.name: UAT Coordination & Sign-Off
tasks.description: Coordinate user acceptance testing. Develop test scripts, manage test execution with client team, track defects, and obtain formal sign-off on test results.

tasks.name: Knowledge Transfer & Project Closeout
tasks.description: Conduct knowledge transfer sessions with client IT team. Compile project documentation package (runbooks, architecture diagrams, config records). Obtain formal project closure.

tasks.name: FedRAMP Control Mapping & Gap Assessment
tasks.description: Map GCP/Workspace service configurations to FedRAMP Moderate control families (AC, AU, CM, IA, SC, etc.). Identify control gaps requiring customer-side implementation.

tasks.name: System Security Plan (SSP) Documentation
tasks.description: Draft or update System Security Plan sections relevant to the deployment. Document control implementations, boundary diagrams, and data flow descriptions.

tasks.name: Plan of Action & Milestones (POAM) Management
tasks.description: Establish and maintain POAM for identified control gaps. Track remediation progress, set target completion dates, and prepare status for Authorizing Official review.

tasks.name: Authority to Operate (ATO) Package Preparation
tasks.description: Compile ATO package including SSP, POAM, security assessment report artifacts, and risk acceptance documentation. Coordinate with agency ISSO and Authorizing Official.

tasks.name: NIST 800-53 Continuous Monitoring Setup
tasks.description: Implement continuous monitoring procedures aligned to NIST 800-53. Configure automated scanning, log aggregation for audit requirements, and monthly vulnerability reporting.

tasks.name: Cleared Environment Configuration
tasks.description: Configure GCP environment within FedRAMP-authorized boundary. Restrict to authorized regions, enable organization policy constraints, and validate IL2/IL4/IL5 compliance as applicable.

tasks.name: Federal Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
tasks.description: Prepare and deliver status reports tailored to federal audiences (Contracting Officer Representative, ISSO, Authorizing Official). Distinct format from commercial status reports. Includes CDRL compliance.

tasks.name: Gemini Enterprise Enablement
tasks.description: Enable and configure Gemini for Google Workspace across the organization. Set up usage policies, data access controls, and admin reporting. Conduct user onboarding for Gemini features.

tasks.name: Custom AI Agent Development
tasks.description: Design and build custom AI agents using Vertex AI Agent Builder or Dialogflow CX. Define conversation flows, ground agents in client data, and implement guardrails.
